reason: CPTAC discovery cohorts do not include THCA. Available CPTAC cancer types: BRCA, CCRCC, CO, GBM, HNSCC, LSCC, LUAD, OV, PDA, UCEC. Thyroid proteogenomics is NOT a CPTAC dataset and the cptac Python package has no Thyroid module. For THCA protein-level confirmation, the available routes are: (1) TCPA RPPA (~200 cancer-signaling antibodies; unlikely to contain TPO/DIO1/TSHR); (2) TCGA-THCA Cell 2014 supplement MS proteomics (small N, no easy API); both are out of scope for the parallel public-data sweep.
